routes.source: Session/search/task status/app metadata routes use Axum PostgreSQL/read-model/contracts where implemented. App-health JSON snapshot and SSE stream read PostgreSQL app.oa_sync_runs/app.oa_sync_watermarks, job.worker_tasks, and read_model.workbench_snapshots; neither route reads app Mongo alerts/dirty scope state. Background-job active list reads PostgreSQL job.worker_tasks system tasks and returns the legacy Python list envelope. Background-job acknowledge writes PostgreSQL job.worker_task_acknowledgements plus audit/idempotency without mutating worker task status. Background-job retry creates PostgreSQL worker task/outbox/audit/idempotency records and does not execute side effects in the request path.

GET routes use PostgreSQL app.bank_transactions + app.bank_transaction_categories. PATCH category writes lock PostgreSQL app.bank_transactions, replace active app.bank_transaction_categories, append app.bank_transaction_category_events, audit.events, app.write_idempotency_records, and enqueue job.worker_tasks/job.outbox_events read-model rebuild for workbench/search_index/cost_statistics; no app Mongo or OA source database read.

Settings read route is default projection only until settings facts are backfilled. Settings writes use PostgreSQL app.settings_profiles with audit/idempotency. Project settings create/delete use app.project_profiles and soft-deactivation. Project sync creates a PostgreSQL worker task/outbox command from frozen staging scope metadata without request-path OA scans. Data-reset job and direct API route both queue settings_data_reset worker tasks with approval/backup evidence; request path does not execute destructive reset work. Data-reset job status reads use PostgreSQL job.worker_tasks.
